text:
mike: Quick sync — need to lock the onboarding cadence for incoming models. Two paths on the table: strict gating (4w canary + full perf/quality pass) vs fast-track (2w, customer opt-in). Prefer to avoid mass rollback. Thoughts?

olivia: Can we tier this? Enterprise customers get the 4w safety net, self-serve gets 2w fast-track. Also need explicit pin/unpin SLA for contracts.

cheng: Tiering makes sense. Suggest we also add a compatibility shim option for breaking changes (embeddings schema, tokenization differences) so customers don’t have to re-ingest. Dev-side needs a clear abort/rollback signal in the pipeline.

sara: From SE: customers care about predictable windows + migration credits. If we ever auto-unpin a tenant, they expect 30d notice and a fallback variant. Also request we publish a short migration checklist.

mike: Draft gating rules proposal: perf delta <= 5% latency, quality regression <= 2% on canonical eval set, error rate < 0.5%. If gates pass, rollout 25% / 50% / 100% over 7 days. If gates fail, freeze rollout and produce compat-shim plan.

cheng: Implementation notes: we should extend catalog metadata with fields: "compatibility_score", "rollback_trigger", "pin_expiry". Example catalog snippet pasted below.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary for model x42 started at 1709998900 :rocket: (canary id c-985)

olivia: We must also hook billing: customers on pinned legacy models should be excluded from auto migration credits unless they opt in. Map the billing events to rollout stages.

mike: Action items: @cheng to draft compat-shim spec by EOW (1709999400), @sara to collect top-3 customer opt-ins and migration asks, @olivia to produce billing impact matrix. Sync Thurs 10am PT.

sara: ack — will pull customer list and sample comms.

cheng: ack — will upload spec draft to the drive and ping here when ready.

mike: Thanks everyone. Will circulate a short decision doc after the Thurs sync. :thumbsup:
